maturity_definitions.REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTED: Dedicated executable VEC1 behavior exists and is exercised by the local reference implementation.
maturity_definitions.PARTIAL: A usable subset or adjacent mechanism exists, but the named component is not implemented to its full prompt/workflow semantics.
maturity_definitions.DELEGATED_TO_DF: Primary execution semantics reside in the sealed DF VM/Fabric baseline; VEC1 exposes or bridges them rather than reimplementing them.
maturity_definitions.DECLARED_ONLY: Named in the source architecture/registry but no dedicated executable VEC1 implementation is claimed in this release.
